components.title: Telemetry API Service (synthetic)
components.description: REST service that mediates all reads and writes of maintenance telemetry. Fictional demonstration data.

control-implementations.description: Demo implementation statements drafted for review. Check results apply only to local demo predicates.

implemented-requirements.description: Local demo obligation: The reviewed policy bundle for the API allows exactly the role/action/resource combinations declared in the model and denies the independently authored negative cases. Check result: PASS (predicate-bounded; not a statement of control effectiveness). No open gaps recorded by the check.

Local demo obligation: Synthetic audit records captured from the API include actor, action, target, time and outcome for every event type the model declares for the API. Check result: PASS (predicate-bounded; not a statement of control effectiveness). Open gaps: Parameter au-12_odp.01 is organization-defined and unresolved; a qualified reviewer must set it. | Parameter au-12_odp.02 is organization-defined and unresolved; a qualified reviewer must set it.
